content:
We would like to invite you to a collaborative project with the goal to formalize Seymour's decomposition theorem for regular matroids.

In contrast with Mathlib's approach to matroids, we want to:

  • focus on finite matroids, rather than infinite matroids
  • put the independent set representation on the first place, rather than the bases representation
  • move fast towards a concrete goal, rather than building a reusable library

We will nevertheless make sure that our definitions about matroids remain consistent with the Mathlib definitions and we may occasionally upstream parts of our project to Mathlib.

Our repository https://github.com/Ivan-Sergeyev/matroid-decomposition-verification already contains a detailed blueprint.

You can find an introductory presentation here: https://github.com/Ivan-Sergeyev/matroid-decomposition-verification/blob/main/2024%2010%2009%20project%20planning/2024%2010%2009%20talk%20slides.pdf
Edit: 3-sum has been finished; our offer is no longer valid.
